skills.description_zh: Rebrand and white-label open-source applications for commercial deployment under the ZHENYU brand. This skill should be used when deploying, forking, self-hosting, or packaging an open-source app and the user wants it rebranded with the product name "zhenyu" and the bundled 阵雨 (rain shower) icon — e.g. "deploy this open-source tool but rebrand it", "fork and white-label this app as zhenyu", "change the name and logo of this project to zhenyu", "二次开发这个开源项目，改名叫 zhenyu 并换上阵雨图标". Automates product-name replacement and icon swapping across web (React/Vue/Next/Vite), PWA, Electron/Tauri, mobile, and CLI projects.
skills.name: ZHENYU 品牌化二次开发
